investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Pixpath Trips (travel booking); Platform: on-premises data center DC-East, server range 10.121.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster pixpat-prod (kubeadm); Cluster add-ons: CoreDNS, ingress controller, Argo CD; services call external SaaS APIs; direct kubectl changes are recorded by the Kubernetes audit log with AUD- identifiers; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
